from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,shutil,hashlib,os,difflib
root=Path('/private/tmp/logex-lifecycle-compare-bievjxcb');base=root/'base'
current=Path('crates/logex-storage/tests/ingestion_publication.rs').read_text()
adapter=current
start=adapter.index('impl Config {');end=adapter.index('// SyncEngine',start)
adapter=adapter[:start]+adapter[end:]
adapter=adapter[:adapter.index('#[test]\n#[ignore = "release cached-header')]
adapter=adapter.replace('''                    storage
                        .ingest_historical_batch(rows, &measured_headers[*first])
                        .unwrap();''','''                    if !rows.is_empty() {
                        storage.write_historical_batch(rows).unwrap();
                    }
                    storage.record_historical_floor(&measured_headers[*first]).unwrap();''')
adapter=adapter.replace('''                    storage
                        .ingest_canonical_batch(
                            rows,''','''                    if !rows.is_empty() {
                        storage.write_batch(rows).unwrap();
                    }
                    storage
                        .record_verified_canonical_state(
                            &anchor(header),''')
adapter=adapter.replace('''                            Some(&anchor(header)),
''','')
start=adapter.index('                    // Measure a publication boundary');end=adapter.index('            let elapsed = start.elapsed();',start)
adapter=adapter[:start]+'''                    storage.record_historical_floor(header).unwrap();
                }
            }
'''+adapter[end:]
adapter=adapter.replace('    let (headers, blocks) = fixture(&config);','    assert!(!config.durable_checkpoint, "original baseline has no explicit durable checkpoint API");\n    let (headers, blocks) = fixture(&config);',1)
fixture=base/'crates/logex-storage/tests/ingestion_publication.rs';fixture.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True);fixture.write_text(adapter)
manifest=base/'crates/logex-storage/Cargo.toml';original_manifest=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','09a63f55:crates/logex-storage/Cargo.toml'],text=True)
manifest.write_text(original_manifest+'''\n[target.'cfg(target_os = "macos")'.dev-dependencies]\nlibc = "0.2"\n''')
(root/'baseline-adapter.patch').write_text(''.join(difflib.unified_diff(current.splitlines(keepends=True),adapter.splitlines(keepends=True),fromfile='a/crates/logex-storage/tests/ingestion_publication.rs',tofile='b/crates/logex-storage/tests/ingestion_publication.rs')))
artifacts=[json.loads(line)for line in Path('/tmp/logex-lifecycle-196-build.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];paths=[r['executable']for r in artifacts if r.get('executable')];assert len(paths)==1
shutil.copy2(paths[0],root/'candidate-bench')
Path('/tmp/logex-lifecycle-compare-root.txt').write_text(str(root))
env=os.environ|{'CARGO_TARGET_DIR':'/Users/tdenisenko/code/logex/target'}
command=['cargo','test','-p','logex-storage','--test','ingestion_publication','--release','--offline','--no-run','--message-format=json']
with (root/'base-build.log').open('w')as log:r=subprocess.run(command,cwd=base,env=env,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=log)
(root/'base-build.jsonl').write_text(r.stdout)
if r.returncode:raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
paths=[r['executable']for line in r.stdout.splitlines()if (r:=json.loads(line)).get('executable')];assert len(paths)==1
shutil.copy2(paths[0],root/'base-bench')
for label in ['base','candidate']:
 with (root/(label+'-fixture-test.log')).open('w')as log:r=subprocess.run([str(root/(label+'-bench')),'storage_publication_preserves_rows_and_empty_block_progress','--nocapture','--test-threads=1'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 print(label,'fixture',r.returncode,flush=True)
 if r.returncode:raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
print('Both release binaries built and smoke-tested',flush=True)
